in_sanskrit.name: Ram
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rama means delight, pleasure, joy, and is the name of the principal deity in Hinduism. He is the seventh avatar of Vishnu, and is the preserver of the universe in Hindu mythishnavism.

in_hindi.name: रामकिशान
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ramakishan is a combination of the names Ram and Kishan. Ram is the name of the principal deity in Hinduism and means delight, pleasure, joy. Kishan means lord or ruler, and is a common masculine name in India.

in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Name, God's Grace
